title: lepidaploa salzmannii
intro: Lepidaploa salzmannii, commonly known as Salzmann's liverwort, is a type of plant in the family Lepidolaenaceae. It is a non-vascular, liverwort plant that grows in tropical and subtropical regions. Lepidaploa salzmannii has been traditionally used for its health benefits, including the treatment of fever, inflammation, and respiratory issues, due to its therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
